name: objekts Production Desk
description: Diagnoses and estimates video production briefs over a keyless MCP server, and routes submitted briefs to the objekts studio's own production team.

skills.name: Diagnose Production
skills.description: Analyses a video production brief and flags gaps such as unbound authority or missing creative constraints.

skills.name: Estimate Production
skills.description: Produces a cost and scope estimate for a described video production, quoted by the studio in local currency.

skills.name: Submit Production Brief
skills.description: Submits a completed brief to the objekts studio and exposes status lookups on the submitted request.
